# AI Build Kit

> AI Build Kit helps people without a software background and small teams plan, build and run internal tools with an AI coding agent. It installs 19 skills: 6 commands the person types and 13 background skills the commands call.

The person explains what should happen, tries the result and decides on risk. The kit suits internal tools with a manual fallback. The project keeps its code and records in accounts the owner controls. The kit does not host tools or store project records.

Install one route per project:

- Shared installer: `npx skills add gwpicard/ai-build-kit`, then choose agents and install all skills. Ask the agent to run `setup-ai-build-kit`.
- Claude Code terminal app: `claude plugin marketplace add gwpicard/ai-build-kit`, then `claude plugin install ai-build-kit@ai-build-kit --scope local`. Run `/ai-build-kit:setup-ai-build-kit`.

Commands:

- `/setup-ai-build-kit` prepares a project.
- `/shape` turns an idea or fault into a ready piece of work.
- `/implement` builds a ready piece and asks before it merges.
- `/setup-hosting` sets up or checks how the tool runs live.
- `/maintain` checks the records and live copy, and runs upkeep when due.
- `/what-now` says where the project stands and what to do next.

The kit cannot replace a professional developer or provide legal, medical, financial or security advice. Passing checks do not prove that software is safe or right for a purpose.
